snippet.textDisplay:
It makes me wonder if there is going to be more to the game than just side missions and the main story.

When GTA 5 became available on PC (which I assume the sixth game will be a year or two down the line), it had such an incredible level of modding. That is really what made GTA 5 so fun: after you completed all the missions and the main story, there was a crap ton of modding you could do. You could type in codes and run around like the Flash or Ghost Rider, exploding things, or dropping nuclear bombs on the entire city. 

When it eventually comes to PC, I am really hoping it has that same level of modding. There was just a crap ton of modding that you could do in GTA 5. I hope that a year or two down the line, it has that same level of modding.
